challenge.description: A security audit revealed that the API gateway lacks proper authentication controls, exposing model endpoints to unauthorized access. #automation_alex# argues for keeping the gateway in a manual state to avoid disrupting the current deployment pipeline, while #requirements_reuben# insists on a fully governed state to ensure compliance and security.

output.content: The current manual gateway configuration keeps our deployment pipeline running without hiccups. I am willing to accept a temporary reduction in deployment frequency to get this sorted. If we move to a fully governed state, I can live with slower releases for a few weeks. The stability we have now is good, but I do not mind trading some speed for the security upgrade you need. Just let me know when the pipeline will be back to full speed so I can plan the next batch of models.
